        if in_unlock_zone:

                agent_body.total_impulse += abs(force[0]) * delta_time
                agent_body.unlock_counter += 1

                # Wall below, move up
                force = (0, 10)

            # Ensure impulse doesn't exceed limit
            if agent_body.total_impulse > 60.0:
                force = (0, 0)  # Stop movement if impulse is too high

    else:
        # Post-unlock: move to exit zone

            # Continue forward
            force = (10, 0)
            agent_body.total_impulse += abs(force[0]) * delta_time
        else:
            # Hold position in exit zone
            force = (0, 0)
            agent_body.total_impulse += 0  # No force applied
            # Check if in exit zone

                agent_body.hold_counter += 1
                if agent_body.hold_counter >= 5:
                    # Task complete
                    pass

                # Adjust vertical position

                    force = (0, 10)

                    force = (0, -10)
